english: Restart the running VR app to apply the change.
zh-CN: 重启正在运行的 VR 应用以应用此更改。
已就绪，可开始下一次采集。

english: Live status for the OpenXR layer, OpenXR/OpenVR OBS sources, runtime, and recording overscan.
zh-CN: OpenXR 层、OpenXR/OpenVR OBS 源、运行时以及录制过扫描的实时状态。

english: Reading the effective and system OpenXR runtime settings.
zh-CN: 正在读取当前生效的与系统级的 OpenXR 运行时设置。

english: An old OBS source copy is taking over
zh-CN: 存在旧版 OBS 源正在抢占
正在检查运行中的 VR 应用

english: Start an OpenXR or OpenVR app; the preview connects automatically.
zh-CN: 启动 OpenXR 或 OpenVR 应用后，预览会自动连接。

english: The preview connects automatically to OpenXR or OpenVR capture.
zh-CN: 预览会自动连接到 OpenXR 或 OpenVR 采集。
给录制画面留出更多余量。

english: Ask the OpenXR application for a wider FOV and a larger render target while the headset receives the original central crop.
zh-CN: 向 OpenXR 应用申请更大的视场角（FOV）与渲染目标，而头显仍然获得原始的中央裁切画面。

english: The setting is applied the next time the VR application creates OpenXR.
zh-CN: 该设置会在 VR 应用下次创建 OpenXR 时生效。

english: Adds room to the left and right edges of the recording.
zh-CN: 为录制画面的左右两侧增加余量。

english: Adds room above and below the headset crop.
zh-CN: 在头显裁切区域的上方与下方增加余量。

english: Headsets render each eye almost square, so a recording is square until the horizontal expansion outruns the vertical one.
zh-CN: 头显每只眼睛的渲染画面接近正方形，因此在水平扩展超过垂直扩展之前，录制画面都是正方形。

english: Changing these values cannot resize an existing OpenXR swapchain.
zh-CN: 修改这些数值无法改变已存在的 OpenXR 交换链大小。

english: Changes save as you make them. Restart the VR application to apply them.
zh-CN: 改动会即时保存，重启 VR 应用后生效。

english: Smooth motion without changing the headset.
zh-CN: 在不改动头显画面的前提下平滑运动。

english: A filtered virtual camera is applied only to the OBS mirror. The headset continues to receive the original pose and image.
zh-CN: 经过滤波的虚拟相机只作用于 OBS 镜像；头显仍然接收原始的位姿与画面。

english: Turn this off to use the values saved directly on the OBS source.
zh-CN: 关闭后改用直接保存在 OBS 源上的数值。

english: Higher values feel steadier and more floaty; zero disables the filtered camera.
zh-CN: 数值越高画面越稳但漂浮感越强；设为 0 可关闭滤波相机。

english: Reserves edge room for the smoothed camera to pan without exposing black borders.
zh-CN: 为平滑相机预留边缘余量，使其平移时不会露出黑边。

english: of each axis remains after the safety crop
zh-CN: 为安全裁切后各轴保留的比例

english: The installed OBS source polls these settings four times per second. Saved values are used on the next session too.
zh-CN: 已安装的 OBS 源每秒轮询这些设置 4 次；保存的数值也会在下次会话中继续使用。

english: Choose whether UI layers appear in the recording.
zh-CN: 选择 UI 层是否出现在录制画面中。

english: OpenXR composition quad layers can be included in or removed from the OBS mirror without changing what appears in the headset.
zh-CN: 可以在不影响头显画面的前提下，把 OpenXR 合成四边形层包含进 OBS 镜像或从中移除。

english: Controls UI submitted separately from the main projection image.
zh-CN: 控制与主投影画面分开提交的 UI。

english: The filter is applied while the layer builds the mirror image.
zh-CN: 该过滤在层构建镜像画面时生效。

english: Every layer is still submitted to the active OpenXR runtime.
zh-CN: 所有层仍然会提交给当前生效的 OpenXR 运行时。

english: The updated OpenXR layer polls this setting while recording. Restart the VR application once after installing the update.
zh-CN: 更新后的 OpenXR 层会在录制时轮询该设置；安装更新后请重启一次 VR 应用。

english: This affects XR_COMPOSITION_LAYER_QUAD content only. UI drawn directly into the projection eye image, including world-space or post-processed UI, is part of that image and cannot be hidden independently.
zh-CN: 该选项只影响 XR_COMPOSITION_LAYER_QUAD 内容。直接绘制进投影眼图里的 UI（包括世界空间或后处理 UI）属于该图像的一部分，无法单独隐藏。

english: Install the built layer, register its manifest for the current user, and stage the matching OBS source.
zh-CN: 安装已构建的层、为当前用户注册其清单，并部署匹配的 OBS 源。

english: Turn this off to stop OpenXR applications from loading the layer. Installed files and the OBS source remain in place.
zh-CN: 关闭后 OpenXR 应用将不再加载该层；已安装的文件与 OBS 源都会保留。

english: Installs both OpenXR Mirror Capture and OpenVR / SteamVR Mirror Capture sources.
zh-CN: 会同时安装 OpenXR 镜像采集与 OpenVR / SteamVR 镜像采集两个源。

english: Use the release artifacts already built in this repository.
zh-CN: 使用本仓库中已构建好的发布产物。

english: If OBS is open and already has this exact plugin, the installer safely updates only the layer. Close OBS first when the plugin binary has changed; Windows may then ask for administrator permission.
zh-CN: 如果 OBS 正在运行且已装有完全相同的插件，安装程序只会安全地更新层。插件二进制发生变化时请先关闭 OBS，此时 Windows 可能会请求管理员权限。

english: Normal headset runtime is the default
zh-CN: 默认使用头显的正常运行时

english: The manager does not select a simulator when it starts one. Use the simulator only from the testing section below, then restore the headset runtime when testing is finished.
zh-CN: 管理器启动模拟器时不会自动选中它。请只在下方测试区域使用模拟器，测试完成后恢复头显运行时。
打开可选的模拟器工具

english: Opening it here keeps runtime selection explicit and does not pass along a stale simulator environment override.
zh-CN: 从这里打开可以保证运行时选择是明确的，也不会带上过期的模拟器环境变量覆盖。
查看运行时实际看到的内容。

english: Uploads the diagnostics report, layer log and OBS log to filebin.net and copies the share link to the clipboard. The link expires after about a week.
zh-CN: 将诊断报告、层日志与 OBS 日志上传到 filebin.net，并把分享链接复制到剪贴板。链接约一周后失效。

english: The preview will connect automatically when a frame is published.
zh-CN: 有画面输出后，预览会自动连接。

english: Start an OpenXR or OpenVR app; the preview connects automatically.
zh-CN: 启动 OpenXR 或 OpenVR 应用后，预览会自动连接。

english: This view uses the same live preview stream as the Dashboard. OBS does not need to be open.
zh-CN: 此视图与仪表盘使用同一条实时预览流，无需打开 OBS。
